units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 109b:8">Snh. 109ᵇ</cite> <he>ה׳ אתני בינייהו</he> thus they agreed between themselves.
<cite ref="Berakhot 2b:19">Ber. 2ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>ה׳ קאמר ליה</he> he may say so to him, i.e. this is his argument.
<cite ref="Sukkah 26b">Succ. 26ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>חסורי … וה׳ קתני</he> something is left out (in the Mishnah), and it must read thus.
Naz. 2ᵃ, a. fr. וה׳ קאמר (abbr. וה״ק) and he means this.—אי ה׳ (abbr. א״ה) if this be so, introducing an argument.
Gitt. 5ᵃ; a. v. fr.—בר ה׳ fit for such a thing, old enough &c.
Sot. 26ᵇ לאו בר ה׳ הוא he is unable to copulate; a. fr.—אַדְּהָ׳ וה׳ in the meanwhile.
Ib. 18ᵇ אדה׳ וה׳ חזייה וכ׳ Ms. M. (ed. only אדה׳) while this was going on, he saw &c.; a. fr.—כל ה׳ all this, that much.
Targ. Prov. XX, 25.—מטול ה׳, אמטו לה׳, משום ה׳ on account of such (a thing), therefore.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 49:15">Targ. Ps. XLIX, 15</cite>.—
<cite ref="Tamid 32a:77">Tam. 32ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.; v. <cite ref="A02010"><he>אַמְטוּ</he></cite>, <cite ref="M00979"><he>מְטוּל</he></cite>.
Zeb. 14ᵃ לה׳ therefore.—השתא דאתית לה׳ now after coming so far, at this stage of the argument.
Ber. 15ᵇ; a. fr.—ה׳ השתא, v. הַשְׁתָּא.—אפילו ה׳ even so, at any rate.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 27:33">Targ. Y. Gen. XXVII, 33</cite>.—<he>ה׳ נמי</he>, v. <cite ref="N00869"><he>נַמִּי</he></cite>.
